implementation_note: The four-cell semantics remain; execution and CSV recording now follow aggregation_broadcast_error. Custom pairing, resume and offline analysis infrastructure was removed at user request. Full training has not started.

method_definition.RBLA: Original RBLA support-normalized factor aggregation plus fixed-prefix broadcast
method_definition.RBLA+: Current rbla_plus_rank_scale: bidirectional actual-layer scaling alignment plus compact spectral redistribution

axis_definition.left: driver_method: method used for the whole training trajectory
axis_definition.right: broadcast_method: fixed-prefix RBLA or compact spectral plus downlink scale-aligned RBLA+ applied to the SAME pre-canonicalization aggregated factors from this driver and round

interpretation_status: Confirmed by user: two complete training paths; each evaluates RBLA and RBLA+ broadcasts and records post-broadcast accuracy.
cross_error_frequency: Auxiliary offline diagnostics on saved aggregate checkpoints
cross_accuracy_frequency: Every actual update; four broadcast-accuracy curves per dataset

measurement_requirements.snapshot_dtype: Preserve production dtype; high-precision error reference is separate
measurement_requirements.snapshot_contents: raw aggregated A/B before this round's spectral reordering, all non-LoRA model state, client shape/rank/scaling profiles, server scaling, provenance and hash
measurement_requirements.upload_scale_alignment: already determined by the driver path; do not reapply or undo during broadcast comparison
measurement_requirements.error_updates: actual s_i * B_i @ A_i with layer-correct orientation and convolution matricization
measurement_requirements.production_diagonal_replay: same-named broadcast branch must reproduce real client outputs within declared numeric tolerance
measurement_requirements.isolation: shadow broadcast/evaluation must not mutate real model/client state, optimizer, RNG, counters, caches, or training timing
measurement_requirements.four_cell_runtime: broadcast-only timing and incremental memory, from the same resident aggregate within each trajectory/round
measurement_requirements.full_server_runtime: reported separately for the two actual complete driver paths; no fake off-diagonal full-server recomputation

accuracy_claim_status: Historical case selection only; new broadcast cross-accuracies and six paired training runs have not been measured.

accuracy_summary.primary: macro average of held-out accuracy across the ten client models after broadcast
accuracy_summary.retain: per-client accuracy, actual complete rank profile, scaling, dataset split; original server accuracy separately
accuracy_summary.evaluation_data: same full held-out set and preprocessing for both broadcasts and both trajectories
accuracy_summary.deduplication: allowed only when entire post-broadcast model state, layer profiles and evaluation settings match; average still counts every client

attribution.cifar10: All actual scalings are one: within-path broadcast differences isolate spectral redistribution including factor truncation
attribution.mnli_qqp: Actual broadcast comparison includes spectral redistribution and downlink scaling; do not label it a pure isolated SP+ contribution
